_comment: Track 6 (email/follow-ups) cron config. IMPORTANT: Vercel Hobby plan only supports daily-minimum cron intervals (no hourly/sub-daily schedules) and does not guarantee exact-minute execution. Schedule below is once daily at 08:00 UTC as the practical default for this pilot. If the pilot later needs faster follow-up turnaround, this requires upgrading to a Vercel Pro plan (or higher) to unlock more frequent cron schedules.
